title: AssetEditRequested
description: A cut, a resize or a filter somebody wants applied. The original is never changed: the result is a new asset. Keys are snake_case, not the camelCase the rest of leaf uses: this travels inside a Liquid envelope, whose own fields (event_id, occurred_at, event_type, owner_unit_ref) are snake_case and pinned byte-exact by signed golden vectors. The shape follows the wire.

job_id.description: The job to report the edit against.

asset_id.description: The asset to edit, which stays as it is.

edit_params.title: EditParams
edit_params.description: What to do to it. Every step is optional and they apply together; an empty one copies the asset.

crop.title: CropParams
crop.description: The rectangle to keep, in pixels from the top left of the original.

x.description: Pixels from the left edge of the original to the left edge of the rectangle.

y.description: Pixels from the top edge of the original to the top edge of the rectangle.

width.description: How wide the kept rectangle is, in pixels.

height.description: How tall the kept rectangle is, in pixels.

resize.title: ResizeParams
resize.description: The size to come out at, said either by naming a channel's preset or by giving both sides.

preset.description: A named size belonging to a channel. What each one resolves to is the editor's to know, not this shape's.

width.description: How wide to come out, in pixels. Given together with height, instead of a preset.

height.description: How tall to come out, in pixels. Given together with width, instead of a preset.

filters.title: FilterParams
filters.description: How to treat the image. The four multipliers leave it alone at 1.

brightness.description: Multiplier on how light it is. Below 1 darkens, above 1 lightens.

contrast.description: Multiplier on the distance between light and dark. Below 1 flattens, above 1 deepens.

sharpness.description: Multiplier on edge definition. Below 1 softens, above 1 sharpens.

vignette.description: Whether to darken the corners. On or off: how much is the editor's to decide.

trim.title: TrimParams
trim.description: The stretch to keep, in seconds from the start. Video only.

start_seconds.description: Where the kept stretch begins, in seconds from the start of the original.

end_seconds.description: Where the kept stretch ends, in seconds from the start of the original.
